learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to recall the basic structure and instruction set of Arm Cortex M4-based microcontrollers.
Students will be able to develop software in low-level and high-level languages.
Students will be able to use the tools and methods for software development.
Students will be able to analyze, design, and implement microcontroller-based systems.
Students will be able to understand the value of embedded systems.

syllabus_topics: Examination of ARM ISA structure: Arithmetic and logic commands, Load/store commands, big/little endian concepts
Load/store commands, addressing modes, Branch commands, conditional commands
Subroutine commands (BL, BX LR), passing arguments in registers, passing arguments in stack, Recursive functions (preserving environment via stack)
bibliography: Embedded Systems with ARM Cortex-M Microcontrollers in Assembly Language and C : Third Edition, Yifeng Zhu, 2017
ARM System-on-Chip Architecture, Steve Furber, 2nd Edition
Embedded Systems: Introduction To ARM Cortex-M Microcontrollers, Jonathan W. Valvano
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
